title: Papiamento: open data for Aruban Papiamento
description:
An open, citable reference dataset for Aruban Papiamento (pap-AW), written in the etymological orthography of the AB 2018 no. 68 law. It contains the headwords of the AB 2018 word list with English, Dutch and Spanish translations, numbers, calendar terms and public holidays, barbarismos, loanwords, closed word classes, proper names, verb forms, a Curaçao-to-Aruba spelling map, everyday sentence prompts for translation (CC0), spelling and grammar rules, and machine-readable checker rules with tests. Every row cites a source document and printed page, and carries a review status (draft, reviewed, disputed, deprecated).

The data is kept and corrected at github.com/ARUBAGOV33/papiamento. Each archived version is a snapshot of that repository at the release tag. The release notes give the number of rows per table and status.

Parts of the dataset were made with the help of AI models (Claude, by Anthropic): rebuilding the word list from the AB 2018 PDF, drafting the translations, and restating the grammar rules. Each piece was checked against the page images, and the maintainer decided every conflict between sources. Machine-made content stays marked as draft until the review board checks it against the source page. See "How this dataset was made" in the README.
notes: Code in tools/, tests/ and .github/ is licensed under Apache-2.0. The files in sources/pdf/ keep their own terms, recorded in sources/sources.tsv. Text quoted from a source keeps that source's terms.
